description: Module register: every workspace package in packages/, its plan brief and the workspace packages it may depend on. Shared file: change it in small, separate pull requests. Checked by `pnpm check:imports`.

packages.purpose: Shared contracts: context, ids, errors, Result, Clock and the core ports with in-memory fakes. No I/O and no dependencies.
Test kit: tenant matrix runner, adapter contract harness, frozen clock, fixtures and pool-leak helper.
Checks that keep the foundation honest and extractable: import graph, manifest validator, boundary lint and public-API diff.
Tenant isolation that is automatic and provable: lifecycle, fail-closed context, row-level security, resolution and organisation units.
Identity and access: credentials, sessions, MFA, roles and permissions as data, service accounts and OAuth for AI clients.
Entitlements and module registry: installed modules, plans, limits, usage metering and feature flags.
Configuration and custom fields: scoped config with versions, labels, lookup lists, typed fields, the condition language and bundles.
Workflow engine: definitions and instances, guards, stage requirements, actions, SLA timers and approvals as data.
Event bus and jobs: transactional outbox, dispatch with retries and dead letters, job queue with tenant fairness and a scheduler.
Audit trail: append-only rows written in the same transaction, tamper-evident hash chain, sensitive-read logging and audit query.
Privacy desk: notices and consent, data requests with clocks, retention, erasure and export, incident log and breach clocks.
Files and vault: blob storage port, file model, secure upload and download, document types with expiry, scanning and quotas.
